name: Turf Toe / First MTP Sprain
definition: Sprain of the plantar capsuloligamentous complex of the first metatarsophalangeal joint, usually from forced hyperextension during sport.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess fracture/sesamoid position; MRI can grade severe plantar-plate injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: High-grade unstable injuries may require repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-anguli Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Sprain of the plantar capsuloligamentous complex of the first metatarsophalangeal joint, usually from forced hyperextension during sport.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
